Subject: Demo invite for Tuesday — join link missing in GCal

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for scheduling the product walkthrough for next Tuesday. I just accepted the calendar invite but the event body in Google Calendar shows no join link — the description only has internal notes and the Meet link appears to have been stripped by our org SSO. Sam and I are blocked from joining.

Screenshot attached (calendar-screenshot.png). Can you either resend the invite with a Zoom backup link or provide a short join URL we can use? We still prefer the 2:00pm PT slot if that still works on your side.

Also — our security team flags external Meet links in some cases; Zoom fallback is usually fine.

Appreciate the quick help,
Alicia Chen

alicia.chen@pegasusanalytics.com

Hi Alicia — sorry about that, and thanks for the screenshot.

We believe your org's calendar policy is stripping external Meet embeds; we'll reprovision the invite from our Zoom account as a fallback and include a short join URL and a regenerated .ics attachment.

Quick questions so we do this once:
- Does 2:00pm PT on Tue still work for you and Sam?
- Any attendee who needs dial-in numbers (country) or a webex-style passcode?

I'm looping in Ben from Customer Ops to handle the .ics regeneration and to make sure the organizer claim is set so the invite shows the Zoom link for external guests.

I'll send the updated invite in about 10–15 minutes.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Thanks for the tag, Mina. Operational steps below — I'll take point on reissuing the invite.

Plan:
1) Create a new Zoom meeting under the team Zoom account (host: ops@redwood.com). Enable passcode and include local dial-in numbers for US and UK.
2) Generate a fresh .ics (redwood-regenerated.ics) with the Zoom join URL in both the LOCATION and DESCRIPTION fields — this increases chance GCal surfaces it for external guests.
3) Set the organizer to ops@redwood.com using the admin organizer-claim flow so external attendees see the Zoom link instead of our internal Meet stub.
4) Send the invite and include a tiny text file with the short link (zoom-shortlink.txt) in the email body and as an attachment for folks who prefer copying the URL.

HubSpot: I'll link the invite and note the activity on DEAL-7890 after sending.

Attendee question: Mina — should we also invite your AE teammate Vanessa as co-host so she can admit guests if the passcode gets removed?

I'll go ahead and do this now and post back with the shortlink. ETA ~8 minutes.

- Ben
